artifact_observations.location: Main label area on the blue can body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text attempts to mimic branding but fails to form coherent words. Characters are malformed, fused, or nonsensical (e.g., 'U.U.C'), which is a classic AI generation artifact.
The geometry of the spray nozzle is slightly amorphous and lacks the crisp mechanical definition of a real plastic actuator. It blends slightly into the neck of the can.
The wood grain texture appears somewhat repetitive and lacks fine high-frequency detail, looking slightly 'painted' rather than photographic.
